requestedOwner: L14/IP-CONTROL plus the I09 canonical Control Plane registry owner
targetSeam: Canonical control registry, command validation/service, durable command receipt, and existing Control Room adapter; do not overload SET_KILL_SWITCH
reason: The diagnostic plane needs a separately scoped fail-closed latch without changing capital, Risk, reconciliation, recovery, or deterministic product readiness.
contract: Proposed control ID diagnostic-plane.kill and proposed backend command ID SET_DIAGNOSTIC_PLANE_KILL are new draft identifiers, not existing authority.
Payload is a closed desired state ENGAGED or DISENGAGED plus expected revision, expiry, reason, digest, and server-derived operator.
ENGAGED and UNKNOWN block new diagnostic runs, provider-stub eligibility, tool activity, isolated patch work, and non-money handoff preparation.

ENGAGED immediately revokes new diagnostic capability, commands the canonical owner to cancel in-flight work within a bounded deadline, rejects late results, and requires a durable cancellation receipt; the diagnostic agent cannot re-enable itself.
Trace append, independent retention, ledgering, deterministic safety, reconciliation, risk reduction, exposure visibility, and product readiness continue unchanged.
Command follows preview, digest and revision confirmation, submit, durable result, before and after readback, and correlation trace.
tests: Duplicate idempotency key returns the prior durable result without a second effect.
Stale revision, expired command, browser-supplied identity, and unsupported state reject exactly.
ENGAGED and UNKNOWN deny new diagnostic work while retained audit evidence continues.
In-flight cancellation produces a trace and cannot delete or rewrite prior evidence.
Resume requires authorized revision plus fresh sandbox, workload identity, privacy, and independent-retention evidence.
No diagnostic kill transition changes deterministic product or trade readiness.
expectedBehavior: Render disabled until the canonical owner supplies and proves the backend command.
Keep the existing financial SET_KILL_SWITCH semantics untouched.
Expose desired, effective, pending, rejected, expired, and readback states with exact reason codes.
Never claim WIRED_LIVE from this packet.

controlDraft.label: Diagnostic plane kill
controlDraft.explanation: Fail-closed latch for optional diagnostic work only; it creates no financial, recovery, or product-readiness authority.
controlDraft.backendOwner: I09 canonical Control Plane registry and L14/IP-CONTROL command owners
safeBounds: Desired state is exactly ENGAGED or DISENGAGED.
Expiry is server-validated and no more than 30000 milliseconds after issue.
ENGAGED cancels in-flight work within 5000 milliseconds and rejects late results.
controlDraft.desiredEffectiveSemantics: Desired and effective states remain separate; UNKNOWN effective state is treated as ENGAGED until canonical readback.
controlDraft.confirmationText: Confirm diagnostic-plane kill transition; deterministic product behavior and retained evidence continue unchanged.
invariants: No diagnostic agent can re-enable itself.
Trace append and independent retention continue while engaged.
No transition changes Risk, Capital, reconciliation, recovery, or product readiness.
telemetry: Durable command receipt with idempotency key and correlation ID.
Desired and effective readback with revision and reason code.
Cancellation deadline, cancellation receipt, and late-result rejection count.

requestedOwner: I03 lifecycle, I08 supervisor, and I13 deployment/configuration owners
targetSeam: Existing provider configuration boundary and canonical lifecycle/supervisor projection; deployment retains workload-identity and secret-reference ownership
reason: A future diagnostic provider needs a non-secret, generation-fenced workload-identity lifecycle, while NOT_CONFIGURED remains a complete and valid product state.
contract: Consume WorkloadIdentityEventV1 evidence with monotonic sequence, generation, binding, subject, audience, capability, lifetime, rotation, revocation, and proof digests.

Never project a token, credential value, environment-variable contents, secret payload, static cloud key, or provider SDK response; retain only the non-secret environment identifier required for binding.
NOT_CONFIGURED, revoked, expired, mismatched, rotating, failed, and unknown identities deny only optional diagnostic-provider use.
Rotation cannot widen capability digest and stale generations cannot complete or re-enable a provider.
Any external activation remains owner-authorized under I00 section 20 and is outside this packet.
tests: NOT_CONFIGURED is stable, visible, and has productReadinessImpact NONE.
Illegal transition, sequence gap, time regression, stale generation, audience mismatch, binding mismatch, and capability widening fail closed.
Revocation and expiry immediately deny diagnostic eligibility.
No fixture, log, view model, or receipt contains secret-bearing fields.
expectedBehavior: Mount only after the canonical owner maps source evidence into the packet contract.
Keep provider calls disabled when configuration or identity truth is absent.
Do not add a new supervisor component identity or a second lifecycle authority.

requestedOwner: I08 supervisor read-model owner plus IP-CONTROL/I10 cockpit adapter owner
targetSeam: Existing supervisor extension/read adapter and the existing Health, Control Room, Logs, and incident surfaces; never a fourteenth canonical component
reason: Operators need honest diagnostic-worker, sandbox, identity, privacy, retention, promotion, repair, corpus, cost, outage, and kill posture without UI recomputation.
contract: Consume DiagnosticWorkerViewV1 as render-neutral data and retain SYNTHETIC_ONLY or NOT_CONFIGURED source labels.

Show desired and observed lifecycle, provider/model revision, identity generation and expiry, sandbox decision, permission and capabilities, run/correlation, nullable budgets, privacy, append receipt, verifier, repair postcondition, corpus disposition, and kill state.

Project the exact D-LAUNCH-13 owner-law digest, Class A-D route, deterministic trigger and special trigger evidence, shadow requirement and exercise, policy and candidate bounds, all nine Class A evidence IDs, and monitored or active demotion triggers without recomputation.
A Class A PASS is registered-only eligibility evidence: operationalActionAllowed remains false in this packet, and the canonical Control Plane remains the only command owner.
Provider self-report alone never produces green; independent trace retention and required verifier evidence must pass.
Provider outage renders planeAvailability UNAVAILABLE; NOT_CONFIGURED renders planeAvailability NOT_CONFIGURED; both retain productReadinessImpact NONE.
Never render raw prompts, raw evidence, credential material, or a functional control without its canonical backend command.
tests: NOT_CONFIGURED, outage, kill-engaged, identity-expired, retention-unknown, and synthetic-ready fixtures render distinct states.
Null budget or timestamp values remain null rather than fabricated zero.
Reason codes and capabilities are stable-sorted and duplicate-free.
Class A trigger, shadow, numeric bounds, nine-point evidence, and recurrence/drift/assumption demotion fields round-trip through the closed view schema.
Sensitive fields are absent and source state can never be LIVE_PUBLIC.
All pending controls remain disabled with the exact owner and command blocker.
expectedBehavior: Project into the existing Health, Control Room, Logs, and incident drill-down surfaces without creating a new cockpit shell.
Use canonical supervisor and control owners for runtime truth and command state.
Never infer recovery, operational authority, product readiness, or execution authority from this view.
